summary: Drain final world-sim validator samples and enforce weekly coverage minimums
details: Keep 2500 work rounds and advance only empty BTC blocks during recoverable finalization; require every captured sample to finish validation before session_end.
Gate weekly summaries on configured reorg completion, positive historical validation, actual candidate tamper rejection, numeric energy replay and verified outcomes for all required actions.

Record finalization and sample accounting in reports; submission counts and expected reorg mismatches cannot replace positive coverage. Older reports and recovery snapshots without this evidence do not satisfy the new gate.
